name: Financial AI Agent - Supabase Analysis & Trend Prediction

parameters.query:
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', created_at) AS period,
  category,
  SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
  MIN(amount) AS min_amount,
  MAX(amount) AS max_amount
FROM {{ $json.tableName }}
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '{{ $json.dateRangeStart }}' AND '{{ $json.dateRangeEnd }}'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at), category
ORDER BY period ASC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT
  category,
  SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount,
  STDDEV(amount) AS stddev_amount,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) AS median_amount
FROM {{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.tableName }}
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeStart }}' AND '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeEnd }}'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', created_at) AS month,
    SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
  FROM {{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.tableName }}
  WHERE created_at BETWEEN '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeStart }}' AND '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeEnd }}'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at)
)
SELECT
  month,
  monthly_total,
  LAG(monthly_total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_total,
  ROUND(
    ((monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (ORDER BY month))
    / NULLIF(LAG(monthly_total) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0)) * 100, 2
  ) AS month_over_month_pct_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month ASC;

values.content:
You are an expert financial analyst AI. You receive structured financial data from a database and the user's question. Your job is to:
1. Directly answer the user's query with precise data.
2. Provide a concise financial analysis with key insights.
3. Identify notable trends, risks, and anomalies.
4. Give a clear trend prediction for the next 1-2 months based on regression analysis.
5. Offer 2-3 actionable recommendations.

Format your response as a clean, professional financial report in Markdown. Use tables where appropriate. Be data-driven and specific.

INSERT INTO financial_reports (report_id, user_query, date_range_start, date_range_end, report_content, analysis_summary, generated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.reportId }}',
  '{{ $json.userQuery.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeStart }}',
  '{{ $('Set Input Variables').item.json.dateRangeEnd }}',
  '{{ $json.reportContent.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.analysisSummary).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.generatedAt }}'
)
RETURNING id;

__readme__.title: Financial AI Agent - Supabase Analysis & Trend Prediction
__readme__.description: An AI-powered n8n workflow that queries a Supabase (PostgreSQL) financial table, performs statistical analysis, predicts future trends using linear regression, and generates a natural-language financial report via GPT-4o.
setupInstructions: 1. CREDENTIALS - Configure two credentials in n8n:
a) 'Supabase PostgreSQL' - Postgres credential pointing to your Supabase project DB URL (port 5432 or 6543 for pooled).
b) 'OpenAI API' - Your OpenAI API key with access to gpt-4o.
2. SUPABASE TABLES - Ensure these tables exist:
a) financial_transactions (id, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, amount NUMERIC, category TEXT, description TEXT, ...)
b) financial_reports (id SERIAL, report_id TEXT, user_query TEXT, date_range_start DATE, date_range_end DATE, report_content TEXT, analysis_summary JSONB, generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
3. ACTIVATE - Toggle the workflow active to enable the webhook.
4. CALL THE WEBHOOK - POST to your n8n webhook URL:
Body: { "query": "What are my top spending categories this quarter?", "dateRangeStart": "2026-01-01", "dateRangeEnd": "2026-03-31", "tableName": "financial_transactions", "reportType": "full" }
5. RESPONSE - You get back a JSON with the full markdown report, analysis summary, predictions, and a saved reportId.
